newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Reynolds sets IPO price at 4.55 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Reynolds sets IPO price at 4.55 pesos.

text.p: Reynolds Philippine Corp, the country's biggest manufacturer of aluminum sheets and foil, has set the price of its initial public offering at 4.55 pesos, issue manager All Asia Capital and Trust Corp said on Friday.

At this price, the price-earnings multiple of the issue is 10.58 times 1997 forecast earnings per share of 43 centavos. Index-linked stocks in the Philippine market are currently trading at a mutiple of 18 times, All Asia said.
Reynolds is offering a total of 238 million shares. Its proceeds will be used to fund its expansion programme and retire debt.
